tools.name: reach_playbooks
tools.description: START HERE. Return the catalogue of ready-made LinkedIn playbooks — what this server can actually accomplish, as named workflows rather than raw endpoints. Each entry carries its tool sequence, its prerequisites, and the full instructions to run it. Call this first when the user asks what you can do

tools.name: list_accounts
tools.description: Return LinkedIn accounts accessible with the provided API key. If the key is restricted, only allowed account IDs are returned.

tools.name: delete_account
tools.description: Delete a LinkedIn account by account_id. Also clears invitation references before deletion.

tools.name: get_account_quotas
tools.description: Get the quotas configuration and usage counters for a LinkedIn account.

tools.name: update_account_quotas
tools.description: Update one or more quota configuration fields for a LinkedIn account. Only provided fields are updated.

tools.name: get_account_request_logs
tools.description: Get request logs for a LinkedIn account with optional filtering by request_type and pagination using limit/offset.

tools.name: get_account_request_logs_stats
tools.description: Get aggregated request-log statistics for a LinkedIn account, grouped by day, week, or month, with optional action and date-range filters.

tools.name: get_me
tools.description: Call LinkedIn Voyager /me for an account through the stored proxy/cookies and return the normalized profile (same fields as Kanbox uses from /me).

tools.name: list_connections
tools.description: List LinkedIn 1st-degree connections for an account (Voyager dash connections), paged with start/count — same payload as GET /api/linkedin/{account_id}/connections.

tools.name: list_conversations
tools.description: List LinkedIn messenger conversations (Voyager Messaging GraphQL), with optional archived, unread, starred filters and next_cursor paging — same as GET /api/linkedin/{account_id}/conversations. Each item returns conversation_id (the thread id — use this as conversation_linkedin_id when fetching mess

tools.name: list_conversation_messages
tools.description: List messages in a LinkedIn conversation via Voyager ``/messaging/conversations/{id}/events`` (Kanbox ``get_conversation_messages``), with optional created_before paging — same as GET /api/linkedin/{account_id}/conversations/{conversation_linkedin_id}/messages.

tools.name: list_scheduled_posts
tools.description: List scheduled LinkedIn posts for an account, paged. Returns post URNs, text content, and scheduled publish times.

tools.name: update_scheduled_post
tools.description: Update the text and/or scheduled time of an existing scheduled LinkedIn post. post_urn is the URN returned by list_scheduled_posts (e.g. urn:li:ugcPost:…). At least one of text or scheduled_at must be provided.

tools.name: delete_scheduled_post
tools.description: Delete a scheduled LinkedIn post. post_urn is the URN returned by list_scheduled_posts (e.g. urn:li:ugcPost:…).

tools.name: upload_media_from_url
tools.description: Upload an image to LinkedIn by fetching it from a public URL. Returns a digitalmediaAsset URN (urn:li:digitalmediaAsset:…) that can be passed to create_post (single image) or create_multi_photo (multi-photo). Use this instead of upload-media when working as an agent — no binary file upload needed.

tools.name: create_multi_photo
tools.description: Create a LinkedIn multi-photo object from a list of digitalmediaAsset URNs. Returns an identifierUrn (urn:li:fsd_multiPhoto:…) to pass to create_post. author_urn is the urn:li:fsd_profile:… of the connected account (get it from get_me).

tools.name: create_post
tools.description: Create or schedule a LinkedIn post, optionally with a media attachment. For a single image pass a urn:li:digitalmediaAsset:… URN; for multiple images pass a urn:li:fsd_multiPhoto:… URN from create_multi_photo. Set scheduled_at (Unix ms) to schedule; omit it to publish immediately.

tools.name: send_message
tools.description: Send a LinkedIn DM via Voyager createMessage: use conversation_linkedin_id for an existing thread or recipient_linkedin_id for a new DM.

tools.name: scrape_profile
tools.description: Fetch a complete LinkedIn profile (name, headline, company, experience, skills…). Pass a LinkedIn URL, vanity name, internal member ID, or Sales Navigator lead URL. Uses SalesNav API when available for richer data.

tools.name: scrape_search
tools.description: Run one page of a LinkedIn, Sales Navigator, or Recruiter search and return normalized profile rows. Pass the full search URL. Use start+count to paginate (count ignored for standard LinkedIn, fixed ~10/page).

tools.name: visit_profile
tools.description: Simulate a profile view, triggering a 'viewed your profile' notification for the target member.

tools.name: profile_viewers
tools.description: Get the list of members who recently viewed the account's profile (requires LinkedIn Premium).

tools.name: user_posts
tools.description: Get recent posts published by a LinkedIn member (via profileUpdatesV2). Paginate with start/count.

tools.name: scrape_post
tools.description: Fetch likers and/or commenters for a LinkedIn post. Pass the full post URL or slug. Set liked=true and/or comments=true.

tools.name: scrape_my_posts
tools.description: Fetch likers and/or commenters for the account's own recent posts. since_hours limits to posts published in the last N hours (default 24).

tools.name: like_post
tools.description: Like a LinkedIn post on behalf of the connected account. Pass the post URL, slug, or URN.

tools.name: comment_post
tools.description: Post a comment on a LinkedIn post on behalf of the connected account.

tools.name: reply_comment
tools.description: Post a reply to an existing LinkedIn comment. Pass the comment_id (URN) returned by scrape_post as comment_urn — it is used directly as threadUrn.

tools.name: star_conversation
tools.description: Star or unstar a LinkedIn conversation. Set star=false to remove the star. conversation_linkedin_id is the conversation_id returned by list_conversations.

tools.name: archive_conversation
tools.description: Archive or unarchive a LinkedIn conversation. Set archive=false to unarchive. conversation_linkedin_id is the conversation_id returned by list_conversations.

tools.name: delete_conversation
tools.description: Permanently delete a LinkedIn conversation. conversation_linkedin_id is the conversation_id returned by list_conversations.

tools.name: react_message
tools.description: Add or remove an emoji reaction on a LinkedIn message. Set react=false to remove the reaction. message_urn is the message_urn returned by list_conversation_messages (e.g. urn:li:msg_message:(urn:li:fsd_profile:…,123456789)). emoji is a Unicode emoji character (e.g. 👍, ❤️). Pass conversation_linkedi

tools.name: connect
tools.description: Send a connection request to a LinkedIn member. Optional message capped at 300 chars (premium) or 200 chars.

tools.name: invitation_status
tools.description: Get the connection and invitation status between the connected account and a LinkedIn member. Returns is_connection, invitation_type (SENT/PENDING/WITHDRAWN/REFUSED).

tools.name: withdraw_invitation
tools.description: Withdraw a pending sent connection request.

tools.name: accept_invitation
tools.description: Accept a pending received connection request.

tools.name: decline_invitation
tools.description: Decline/ignore a pending received connection request.

tools.name: remove_connection
tools.description: Remove an existing 1st-degree connection.

tools.name: follow
tools.description: Follow or unfollow a LinkedIn member without connecting. Set follow=false to unfollow.

tools.name: list_received_invitations
tools.description: List pending connection invitations received by the account (with invitation_secret to accept them).

tools.name: list_sent_invitations
tools.description: List pending connection invitations sent by the account that have not yet been accepted.

tools.name: salesnav_list_thread_messages
tools.description: Fetch a Sales Navigator thread with all its messages and participant profiles (salesApiMessagingThreads/{id}). Requires a Sales Navigator subscription. Use the thread id returned by salesnav_list_messaging_threads. message_count controls how many (most recent) messages are returned; compare with tot

tools.name: salesnav_send_message
tools.description: Send a message in an existing Sales Navigator thread (salesApiMessageActions). Requires the account to have a Sales Navigator subscription. Use the thread id returned by salesnav_list_messaging_threads.

tools.name: salesnav_list_messaging_threads
tools.description: List Sales Navigator messaging threads (salesApiMessagingThreads). Requires the account to have a Sales Navigator subscription (has_sales_nav). Returns threads with messages and participant profiles. Paginate by passing next_page_starts_at from the previous response as page_starts_at.

tools.name: salesnav_resolve_industry
tools.description: Resolve an industry name (any language) to its LinkedIn Industry Code(s) using the bundled Industry Codes V2 taxonomy (offline, no LinkedIn call). Returns ranked candidates with id, label and hierarchy path. Use the returned id(s) in salesnav_build_search_url's `industry` filter. Call once per indus

tools.name: salesnav_typeahead
tools.description: Live Sales Navigator autocomplete for facets whose ids are dynamic. Use type='geo' to resolve a location to its REGION id (the only reliable way — LinkedIn region ids are not enumerable), and type='company' / 'school' / 'title' for those entity facets. Returns [{id, displayValue, headline}]. Feed th

tools.name: salesnav_build_search_url
tools.description: Build a Sales Navigator people-search URL from structured lead-search filters, using as many filters as the request implies. RESOLUTION: `industry` accepts numeric ids OR names (auto-resolved via the taxonomy); `region` accepts numeric REGION ids OR location names (auto-resolved via geo typeahead —

tools.name: list_webhook_endpoints
tools.description: List the webhooks registered for this user: the URLs Reach calls when a conversation gets a new message (message.received), the account gains a 1st-degree connection (connection.new), an account changes connection state (account.status_changed) or a daily quota is close to or at its limit (quota.thr

tools.name: create_webhook_endpoint
tools.description: Register a URL to be called when something happens on LinkedIn, so an agent or an n8n/Make workflow can react instead of polling. Returns the signing secret ONCE; deliveries carry 'Reach-Signature: t=<unix>,v1=<hex HMAC-SHA256(secret, t + '.' + body)>'. Events: message.received, connection.new, acco

tools.name: update_webhook_endpoint
tools.description: Change a webhook's url, events, account_ids, description or is_active. Only provided fields change. Re-enabling clears the failure counter.

tools.name: delete_webhook_endpoint
tools.description: Delete a webhook endpoint and its delivery history.

tools.name: test_webhook_endpoint
tools.description: Send a signed 'ping' event to a webhook endpoint right now and report the HTTP status it answered.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: list_conversations, list_conversation_messages, list_scheduled_posts, scrape_profile, scrape_search, visit_profile, user_posts, scrape_post, scrape_my_posts, react_message, salesnav_list_thread_messages, salesnav_list_messaging_threads, salesnav_build_search_url, list_webhook_endpoints · Private data: list_accounts, upload_media_from_url, create_webhook_endpoint · Public sink: list_scheduled_posts, update_scheduled_post, delete_scheduled_post, upload_media_from_url, create_post, send_message, scrape_post, like_post, comment_post, reply_comment, connect, salesnav_send_message, list_webhook_endpoints, create_webhook_endpoint, update_webhook_endpoint, delete_webhook_endpoint, test_webhook_endpoint · Destructive: reach_playbooks, delete_account, delete_scheduled_post, scrape_search, star_conversation, delete_conversation, react_message, remove_connection, salesnav_build_search_url, delete_webhook_endpoint.

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
